test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 62

questions.question: Jagatt, Sathvika and Ujwal enter into a business partnership by investing Rs.5,000 , Rs. 4000 and Rs. 6000 respectively. Find their respective shares in the total profit of Rs.4200 earned at the end of the year.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Rs1,400, Rs1,120, Rs1,680) है।

questions.question: There are two sections A and B of a class, consisting of 22 and 44 students, respectively. If the average weight of section A is 40 kg and that of section B is 32 kg, find the average weight of the whole class (in kg, rounded off to two decimal places).

A shopkeeper gives a 15% discount on the marked price of his bags and offers two bags free for every eight bags purchased, thus making a profit of 12%. At what percentage above the cost price should the shopkeeper mark his bags? (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)

A and B started a business with an investment of ₹2,800 and ₹5,400, respectively. After 4 months, C joined with ₹4,800. If the difference of C's share and A's share in the annual profit was ₹412, what was the total annual profit?

Divide 555 into three parts such that the second part is four-fifths of the first and the third part is five-sixths of the second. What is the fourth proportional to the first, second and the third parts?
